summary: Generate Export Documentation, Including A Certificate Of Analysis Ref
businessObject: Outbound Delivery (Export) with Export Documentation Package

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Create Outbound Deliveries" Fiori app with export documentation output.
The system attaches or references the Certificate of Analysis associated with the shipped batch.
The system generates required export documents (commercial invoice, packing list) reflecting HS codes and country-of-origin data from the material master.
The delivery cannot be goods-issued for export until all mandatory export document types have been generated.
The system flags shipments requiring an export license and blocks goods issue if the license is missing or expired.
All generated export documents are archived and retrievable against the delivery for customs audit purposes.

HP.description: Create export delivery with all master data complete, CoA attached, valid license → generate all required docs (invoice, packing list) → verify CoA reference included → verify archive link created → PGI success → verify goods issue document number

AP.description: Multi-line delivery (multiple materials/batches) → each material has HS code & origin → each batch has CoA → consolidated export docs generated with all CoAs referenced
Retrieve archived export documents after PGI for customs audit purposes → verify all docs accessible via Archive Link

NEG.description: Batch exists but no Certificate of Analysis attached in QM/DMS → system error or warning on doc generation attempt → PGI blocked
Material master missing HS code (MARC-STAWN blank) → export document generation fails with error message
Material master missing country of origin (MARC-HERKL blank) → export document generation fails with error message
Export license required but missing in master data (MEAN-EXTWG set, EIPA record missing) → system flags shipment → PGI blocked with error
Export license expired (EIPA-GLTBIS < today) → system flags shipment → PGI blocked with error
Attempt PGI before all mandatory export documents generated (NAST output incomplete) → system blocks with error message listing missing doc types
Mandatory document type configured for country but generation failed → PGI blocked even if some docs generated

ERR.description: Missing Sales Order → delivery creation fails with error
Missing Material → delivery creation fails with error
Missing Batch (for batch-managed pharma material) → delivery creation fails or picking incomplete
Missing or invalid Shipping Point → delivery creation fails with error

EDGE.description: Export license expiring today (EIPA-GLTBIS = sy-datum) → boundary = still valid → PGI allowed
Export license expiring tomorrow (EIPA-GLTBIS = sy-datum + 1) → PGI allowed but system warning
Minimum quantity (0.001) delivery → export docs generated correctly with decimal precision
Maximum number of delivery line items (999) → all CoAs referenced, consolidated docs generated without truncation

INT.description: QM inspection lot exists but CoA document generation pending in QM module → delivery creation allowed but doc generation warns/fails → PGI blocked
DMS archive link broken or DMS interface down → document archival fails → PGI may succeed but audit trail incomplete (depends on config)
Material master maintained but plant-specific export data missing (MARC record exists but STAWN/HERKL blank at plant level) → doc generation fails

boundary.label: Export License Validity Date
